name: Barbell Front Squat
steps: Rack a barbell across your front shoulders with a clean or cross-arm grip, step back with feet shoulder-width apart, and lift your elbows high.
Brace your core tightly and keep your chest proud.
Bend your knees and hips to descend as far as you can while keeping your elbows lifted and your feet flat.
Drive evenly through your midfoot and heels to stand tall while keeping your elbows elevated.
tips: Keep your elbows pointing high and forward so your upper back does not round under the bar.
Keep your heels grounded flat on the floor throughout the full depth of the squat.
